meta.title: AVITEK KUKM — Association of Technology Innovation for Cooperatives and SMEs
meta.description: AVITEK KUKM carries forward the results of the 2023–2026 Korea–Indonesia Smart Factory ODA project and connects cooperatives, SMEs, academia, industry, and government.
meta.fullName: Association of Technology Innovation for Cooperatives and SMEs

nav.insightsStoriesSub: Cooperatives and SMEs already running smart factories

hero.title: Smart factories don't stop when the project ends.
hero.lede: From 2023 to 2026, the Korea–Indonesia Smart Factory ODA project helped 30 cooperatives and SMEs adopt smart production technology. AVITEK KUKM exists so those results keep being used, improved, and passed on to more businesses.
hero.venue: 2nd Floor Auditorium, Ministry of Cooperatives of the Republic of Indonesia, Jl. H.R. Rasuna Said Kav. 3–4, South Jakarta
hero.visualLabel: Illustration of the 30 beneficiary cooperatives and SMEs connected to AVITEK KUKM
hero.visualCaption: cooperatives and SMEs already run smart factories
hero.hubText: becomes their shared home after the ODA project ends.

track.title: Four years of Korea–Indonesia cooperation
track.intro: AVITEK grew out of a long journey. These are the key milestones since the memorandum of understanding was signed.

items.title: Memorandum of understanding
items.text: Indonesia's Ministry of Cooperatives and SMEs and the INNOBIZ Association signed the smart factory project MoU in Jakarta on 28 February.

items.title: Training center opens
items.text: The Smart Factory Training Center opened at BINUS @Bekasi on 2 December.

items.title: Learning on site in Korea
items.text: Two weeks of training inside Korean smart factories, plus a business cooperation seminar at the SFTC.

items.title: Sharing results
items.text: A seminar at BINUS Alam Sutera where beneficiaries shared the impact of their smart factories.

items.title: AVITEK KUKM launches
items.text: The project reports its results, and the association formally takes over its continuity.

why.title: The technology is installed. Now the ecosystem needs looking after.
why.intro: Grants end; the need for mentoring, training, and networks doesn't. Without a home to carry it on, four years of know-how can easily scatter. AVITEK was formed so the results keep growing.

cards.title: For members
cards.text: Cooperatives and SMEs get a clear path to keep raising production capacity and competitiveness.
points: A forum for members to share practices

cards.title: For partners
cards.text: Industry, technology providers, and universities find implementation partners that are already digitally ready.

cards.title: For Indonesia
cards.text: Digital transformation of cooperatives and SMEs keeps going, without depending on a single project.

pillars.title: Applied research
pillars.text: Real production problems on cooperative and SME factory floors become university research topics.

pillars.title: Active collaboration
pillars.text: Technology providers and members work on joint projects, not just seminars.

pillars.title: Policy advocacy
pillars.text: Member data and experience are passed to government as input for digitalization programs.
